title: Electricity at Home
summary: Cells, bulbs and switches, simple circuits, conductors, and staying safe with electricity.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 7: Energy — How Things Work

objectives: I can make a simple circuit.
I can say which materials let electricity flow.
I can follow safety rules with electricity.
misconceptions: A bulb needs only one wire to light.
Electricity from a wall socket is as safe as a torch cell.
